name: MDS International Congress（國際動作障礙學會年會）
relevance: 動作障礙領域最大國際年會；MSA 臨床與在研療法發表重鎮（Alterity ATH434 曾於 2025 年會發表）。Lundbeck 已公告將於 10/5 發表 amlenetug 樞紐 Ph3 MASCOT 試驗（NCT06706622，n=401）收案多樣性基線資料（Late-breaking oral）、mUMSARS Part I 量表心理計量驗證（含中文版）、腦脊髓液生物標記與一項區分 MSA／帕金森氏症的 C 端 α-突觸核蛋白檢測報告。

en.name: MDS International Congress
en.relevance: The largest international meeting in movement disorders and a key venue for MSA clinical and pipeline presentations (Alterity presented ATH434 data at the 2025 congress). Lundbeck has announced it will present, on 10/5, baseline diversity data from the pivotal Phase III MASCOT trial of amlenetug (NCT06706622, n=401) as a late-breaking oral, psychometric validation of the modified UMSARS Part I scale (including a Chinese-language version), cerebrospinal fluid biomarker work, and a report on a C-terminal alpha-synuclein assay to differentiate MSA from Parkinson's disease.

name: International MSA Congress（Mission MSA）
location: 美國德州達拉斯（The Westin Galleria Dallas，另提供線上參與）
relevance: MSA 專屬國際科學暨臨床大會，集結研究者、臨床醫師、產業與病友。下屆已公布地點與日期，由 Mission MSA 與 UT Southwestern MSA 卓越中心合辦。

en.name: International MSA Congress (Mission MSA)
en.location: Dallas, TX, USA (The Westin Galleria Dallas; virtual attendance also offered)
en.relevance: The MSA-specific international scientific and clinical congress bringing together researchers, clinicians, industry and families. The next edition's location and dates are now announced, co-hosted by Mission MSA and the UT Southwestern MSA Center of Excellence.

name: AD/PD 2027（國際阿茲海默症與帕金森病會議）
location: 西班牙巴塞隆納（國際會議中心，另提供線上參與）
relevance: 阿茲海默症與帕金森病領域之大型國際會議，神經退化性疾病機轉與在研療法（含 α-突觸核蛋白病變，涵蓋 MSA）發表重鎮。摘要截止日已過（2026/09/01），通知結果預計 2026 年 10 月中。尚無公開議程公布具體 MSA 相關發表場次，待後續查核。

en.name: AD/PD 2027 (International Conference on Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Diseases)
en.location: Barcelona, Spain (International Convention Centre; online participation also offered)
en.relevance: A major international conference on Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease, and a key venue for neurodegeneration mechanism and pipeline presentations, including alpha-synucleinopathies (covering MSA). The abstract deadline has passed (2026/09/01), with notifications expected mid-October 2026. No public agenda specifying MSA-related sessions is available yet; to be checked in a future scan.

name: MSA Symposium 2026（MSA Trust）
relevance: 英國 MSA Trust 主辦的研究者研討會。

en.name: MSA Symposium 2026 (MSA Trust)
en.relevance: Researcher symposium hosted by the UK MSA Trust.
